LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerDecree.label: Flower Decree
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerDecree.comps.0.resourceDescr: Qinghe's charge resource, used to cast Four-Season Flower Mandates.
LanguageData.MX_QH_MeditativeStillness.label: Stillness
LanguageData.MX_QH_MeditativeStillness.description: Meditating or reading can accumulate Stillness. When Qinghe makes art or crafts, she consumes Stillness based on the amount accumulated and gains a quality bonus.
LanguageData.MX_QH_MeditativeStillness.comps.0.resour: Qinghe's meditative reserve, accumulated while meditating at the lotus pond.
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerResonance.label: Resonance
LanguageData.MX_QH_AscentSlashInvulnerable.label: damage immunity (Jueying)
LanguageData.MX_QH_AscentSlashInvulnerable.descriptio: Qinghe is airborne during Sword Form: Jueying and temporarily immune to all damage.
LanguageData.MX_QH_DivineBlessing.label: Flower-God Mercy
LanguageData.MX_QH_DivineBlessing.description: When Qinghe would take fatal damage or damage that could destroy a body part, negate the damage, repair all injuries, and gain brief invulnerability and 10 seconds of psychic invisibility. This effect can trigger once every 120 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_QH_DivineBlessingImmunity.label: Divine Response
LanguageData.MX_QH_DivineBlessingImmunity.description: Blessed by the Flower God, temporarily immune to all damage.
LanguageData.MX_QH_DivineGrace.label: Flower-God Benediction
LanguageData.MX_QH_DivineGrace.description: The visible sign of Qinghe's mastery. As its level rises, Qinghe's base abilities improve.
LanguageData.MX_QH_DivineFortune.label: Flower-God Fortune
LanguageData.MX_QH_DivineFortune.description: Hidden Hediff: unified Qinghe stat proxy.
LanguageData.MX_QH_DivineProtection.label: Flower-God Ward
LanguageData.MX_QH_DivineProtection.description: Qinghe is protected by the Twelve Flower Gods and naturally generates a shield that blocks damage.\n\nWhen broken, the shield is disabled for 10 seconds.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Trickle.label: Trickle
LanguageData.MX_QH_Trickle.description: Qinghe slowly recovers from wounds over time, eventually restoring permanent injuries and missing body parts.
LanguageData.MX_QH_LuoshenContract.label: Luoshen contract
LanguageData.MX_QH_LuoshenContract.description: Hidden state: records the Luoshen contract binding between Qinghe and her spouse.
LanguageData.MX_QH_SpringFlow.label: spring flow blessing
LanguageData.MX_QH_SpringFlow.description: Bathed in spring flow, gaining <color=#FF69B4>increased melee and ranged damage, reduced incoming damage, and reduced pain</color>.
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerDance.label: Nishang Dance
LanguageData.MX_QH_FlowerDance.description: Qinghe enters a dancing state, improving movement speed, dodge, and Flower Decree recovery. Her shield can begin recharging immediately after being hit.
